sn47.41:1.2: “Bhikkhus, you should meditate with your mind firmly established in the four kinds of mindfulness meditation.
sn47.41:1.3: Don’t let freedom from death be lost on you.
sn47.41:1.5: It’s when a bhikkhu meditates by observing an aspect of the body—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.41:1.6: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …
sn47.41:1.8: principles—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.41:1.9: You should meditate with your mind firmly established in the four kinds of mindfulness meditation.
sn47.41:1.10: Don’t let freedom from death be lost on you.”
